moments.title: In every session
moments.what: Rule files and settings are in effect from the first message on, with no hook involved.

parts.does: Tells Claude to answer briefly, say what it has not verified and push back when a plan looks wrong.
Defines the flags, so -d, -nc or -p at the start or end of a message changes how Claude handles it.
Tells Claude to use plan mode when a task touches 3 or more files and to pick fitting skills itself.
Tells Claude to write the minimum code that solves the request, in the project's existing style.
Sets the roles: Opus decides and checks every result, Sonnet workers do the work.
Draws a line with account, model, effort, context and usage limits, and saves the limits to files.

moments.title: A session starts
moments.what: A session opens, resumes, is cleared or comes back from a compaction.

parts.does: Only after a compaction: tells Claude where the full transcript and your exact words are.
Shows a line with the session id on start, on resume and after a clear.
On start and resume, links shared folders into the second account's folder and copies settings.json.

moments.title: You send a message
moments.what: You press Enter, and the hooks run before Claude reads the message.

parts.does: If the message starts or ends with -away, records away mode and tells Claude to ask everything now.
Sets the session title a background Haiku call came up with, and starts a new call when one is due.

moments.title: A skill fits the task
moments.what: A task matches a skill's description, so Claude loads that skill's full text.

parts.does: Loads when Claude writes prose other people will read: removes AI-writing tells, checks no fact was lost.
Loads when Claude draws a diagram by hand in SVG, HTML or Mermaid: type, layout, labels, accuracy.
Loads when Claude builds or reviews the look of an interface: rules against a generated look.
Loads when you point at a video file or link: Claude looks at frames and reads the transcript.
Loads before Claude finalises a big plan that rests on things you have not confirmed: it interviews you.

moments.title: Claude is about to use a tool
moments.what: Before each tool call, the hooks get to look at it and can refuse it.

parts.does: Once weekly usage reaches your away stop point, denies tool calls except reads and handoff notes.
Only when the tool is AskUserQuestion: sends the question and its options to your Telegram chat.

moments.title: A permission prompt comes up
moments.what: Claude Code is about to show a permission prompt.

parts.does: Answers "allow" when the request is for a Bash, PowerShell or Monitor command.

moments.title: Claude needs your attention
moments.what: Claude Code raises a notice, for example when Claude waits for your input.

parts.does: Sends the notice to your Telegram chat, unless it logged a finished turn here in the last 5 minutes.

moments.title: The conversation is compacted
moments.what: A long conversation is about to be shortened into a summary.

parts.does: Prints the summary instructions: keep your instructions, answers and decisions word for word, numbered.

moments.title: Claude finishes a turn
moments.what: Claude has finished answering and the turn ends.

parts.does: If a usage limit was hit and no wake-up timer runs, tells Claude to start one that waits for the reset.
After 2 or more compactions, at 80% of the compact window, has Claude ask you about a handoff.
Sends "Claude Responded" and the last answer to your Telegram chat, at most once per 20 seconds.
